latestVersion.changelog:
Music Cog Online 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches seamless AI music synchronization for videos via a cloud-based pipeline.
- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, MP3, WAV files up to 500MB and exports 1080p MP4.
- No manual editing required: describe your intent (e.g., "sync background music to my video"), and get ready-to-download results.
- Features automatic setup, session handling, and credit management with anonymous token support.
- Batches and iterates on video/music edits; manages draft timelines and exports via API.
- Includes robust error handling and quick workflows designed for content creators.
